title: Darth Vader
subtitle: Unstoppable
text: Action [Exhaust, discard a card from your hand]: Deal 1 damage to a unit or base.
deployBox: On Attack: Discard any number of cards from your hand. Deal damage to a unit or base equal to the number of cards discarded this way.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 7 or more resources, deploy this leader.
